_comment: Dev-only resolution. tsx runs the worker as a Node ESM process. The compiled package dist/ uses extensionless ESM imports (module=ESNext, moduleResolution=Bundler) which only a bundler can consume — not raw Node ESM. So in dev we resolve internal @repo/* packages directly from their TypeScript source, which tsx executes natively. Production (pnpm build + node dist/index.js) is unaffected and still consumes built output.
